Upper Division Clerk (UDC): Holding analogous posts on regular basis. LDC in Level-2 with 8 years regular service. 30 wpm in English typewriting. Knowledge in word processing.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the MEPZ SEZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by MEPZ Special Economic Zone Tamil Nadu (MEPZ SEZ) under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry to fill various administrative and ministerial positions on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies have been announced for posts including Assistant, Junior Translation Officer, Stenographer Grade II & III, and Upper Division Clerk in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for MEPZ SEZ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must send their duly filled application forms through the proper channel to the designated official address before the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Assistant post must possess a degree from a recognised University or equivalent, along with knowledge in word processing and a minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts advertised under this notification is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of the application form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary scale for the Junior Translation Officer post?
faq.answer: The Junior Translation Officer position carries a salary under Level-6 of the Pay Matrix in accordance with the 7th CPC guidelines, equivalent to pre-revised PB-2 with Grade Pay Rs. 4200.

faq.question: Q7. What are the required documents to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach complete and up-to-date APARs for the last five years, an Integrity Certificate, Vigilance Clearance, details of penalties if any, and a formal NOC from their Head of Department.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for MEPZ SEZ Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves the initial scrutiny of applications based on eligibility criteria, followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates conducted by the recruiting authority.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with necessary certificates must be sent through proper channel to the Development Commissioner, MEPZ Special Economic Zone, Admin building, G.S.T Road, Tambaram, Chennai-600045.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee specified in the official notification for applying to any of the posts offered through this recruitment advertisement.
